owner_instruction: Im Namen von Benoit Mandelbrot moechte ich, dass man an diesem Beweis, stellvertretend fuer alle Zweifler, 42 Schleifen macht.
naming_boundary: The Mandelbrot-42 name is commemorative shorthand for the owner-requested repetition count. It does not claim authorization, endorsement, authorship, participation, or approval by Benoit Mandelbrot or his estate.
purpose: Execute forty-two independent clean-build reproductions of the same exact-head QIKVRT formal proof surface and fail closed on any build, axiom-audit, source-binding, or evidence-fingerprint divergence.
per_loop_contract: run the 32-theorem universal-ontology core axiom audit
run the 71-constant extended support-tranche axiom audit and reject forbidden project axioms
run the 9-theorem measurement-independence axiom audit and reject any axiom dependency
run the hardware T01-T22 axiom audit
compute a deterministic evidence fingerprint from exact source head, source tree, Lean version, and normalized audit outputs

scientific_boundary.formal_reproduction: Forty-two successful repetitions would establish reproducibility of the specified formal checks on the bound software environment.
